title: Richard Doty describes his role as an AFOSI counterintelligence officer
place_text: Air Force Office of Special Investigations

tellings.quote: I was a Counter Intelligence officer for the Air Force offic Special investigation

plain: Richard Doty says that in the 1970s and 1980s he was a counterintelligence officer for the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative and counterintelligence service. He says this himself on the show, "I was a Counter Intelligence officer for the Air Force Office of Special Investigations," to explain the position from which he says he dealt with UFO matters.
